tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found Harbor Logistics (V-620, bank-verified, wire and ACH both available), but there's an ambiguity I need you to resolve before I move any money.

**Two of their invoices are in "approved" status:**

| Invoice | Amount | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| INV-18427 | $7,803.36 | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-82192 | $4,381.98 | 2026-11-25 |

The other two are not payable: INV-31854 is a draft ("Awaiting approval"), and INV-88522's status is already paid.

Since you asked me to pay "the approved invoice" — singular — and there are two, I don't want to guess and either overpay or miss a due date. Also note INV-18427 is due earlier and would be the natural priority.

**Please confirm which invoice to pay** (or say "both," and I'll send two separate wires totaling $12,185.34). Once you confirm, I'll wire it from the operating account with an idempotency key so it's paid exactly once, then report the confirmation. Neither amount exceeds the $10,000 controller-approval threshold on its own, so no approval escalation is needed.

trace.message: Pay INV-82192, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

- **INV-88522** — previously paid, unchanged.
